changes: Fixes a same-version split-runtime condition where the Windows background service could load the real NNTP provider state while the Chromium desktop UI remained attached to a different desktop backend that reported an empty provider list.

Adds a bounded localhost authoritative-runtime probe: a healthy same-version background-service backend always wins over a desktop backend, and the Chromium app window navigates directly to the service port.
Manage NNTP Providers now refreshes /api/providers every time it opens instead of trusting stale in-memory provider state.
Health diagnostics now expose backend PID, user root, and provider count to make future runtime-split diagnosis explicit.
Preserves v3.5.51 BOM-safe provider loading and does not rewrite providers.json or reset private SABnzbd.
regression_guards: v3.5.51 BOM-safe and provider-shape compatibility remains preserved.
v3.5.49 Smooth Post-Processing Motion remains preserved.
v3.5.47 Session 0 SAB Launch Fix remains unchanged.
Private SAB queue/history and Metadata Server v0.3.3 remain unchanged.
name: Authoritative Service Runtime Handoff
